correct_completion: its findings were nevertheless widely cited by other scientists.
full_sentence: Although the study was small, its findings were nevertheless widely cited by other scientists.
acceptable_variants: its conclusions still influenced later research.
its findings were still widely cited.

options.text: so its findings were widely cited by other scientists.
options.why_wrong: 'So' expresses a result, not a contrast. 'Although' needs a clause that contrasts with the small size of the study.

options.text: its findings were nevertheless widely cited by other scientists.
because the sample size was very large.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause, and this clause contradicts the word 'small' in the stem.

options.text: the researchers also collected more data.
options.why_wrong: This adds information but does not contrast with the small size of the study.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must contrast with the first part of the sentence. 'Nevertheless' signals that the contrast is expected but does not change the outcome.
